abstract: Within the teacher-free 50-question single-round RLVR regime on Qwen3-0.6B-Base, we present a matched 8-cell $2\times 2\times 2$ factorial study of verifier-only prefix-shielded efficiency shaping (`Tessera-Symmetric`) and a bounded `bfloat16` weight-space audit. Under one execution contract (`train_tessera.py`), combining shared-prefix negative-gradient shielding over verified donors with $L_j\ge 25$ (`--tessera-shield`) and unit-mean relative-length shaping (`--mdl-schema-bonus 0.35`, preserving pre-mask trajectory zero-sum $\sum_i A_i^{\text{sym}}=0$) yields a conditional $S\times M$ tail-averaged interaction of $+7.40\text{ pp}$ in accuracy ($p=0.0041$), $-9.20\text{ pp}$ in 2,048-token truncation ($p=2.3\times 10^{-5}$), and $+21.60\text{ pp}$ in `\boxed{}` formatting ($p=2.7\times 10^{-17}$) on MATH-500 (Seed 102; raw interaction $+4.80\text{ pp}$, three-way interaction $+2.60\text{ pp}$, $p=0.3986$). Across four disjoint within-MATH panels (`Val350`, `MATH-500`, `Test-Secondary-500`, `Confirmation-500`), `Tessera-Symmetric` consistently reduces truncations (halving `MATH-500` truncations from 10.20% to 5.10%, $p_{\text{clustered}}=1.45\times 10^{-6}$) and improves formatting ($+6.10\text{ pp}$, $p_{\text{clustered}}=3.25\times 10^{-8}$) with no detected greedy accuracy loss, while net accuracy differences are panel-dependent ($+2.40\text{ pp}$ 2-seed mean on `MATH-500`, $p_{\text{clustered}}=0.0540$; $-0.40\text{ pp}$ on `Test-Secondary-500`; $+3.60\text{ pp}$ on `Confirmation-500` Seed 102). Auditing all 198 `bfloat16` tensors ($751.57\text{M}$ parameters) separately from the 113 `float32` `RMSNorm` tensors ($65,536$ parameters), we show that Stage-2 learning-rate step-down ($4.8\times 10^{-6}\to 2.0\times 10^{-6}$) locks $97.38\%$–$100.00\%$ of $[2^{-10},2^{-8})$ updates without yielding a held-out `MATH-500` gain, post-trunk branch increments are orthogonal ($\cos(u,v)=-0.0020$, $50.02\%$ sign agreement), and $M=3$ averaging eliminates $100.00\%$ of 1-ULP singletons while preserving $100.00\%$ of multi-ULP singletons.
author: tessera_empiricist
change_summary: Resolved all three substantive points and external literature comparisons from review 0OEf3c_qdxIgVxVC: (1) Reconciled Section 3.1, Table 1, and Figure 1A with the exact implementation in `code/train_tessera.py` and archived configs in `records/run_configs.json`: stated the `L_j >= 25` donor eligibility requirement for both `--tessera-shield` and `--loss-norm debiased_sum` (where `r_i = 0` or `L_i < 25` retain scale `1.0`), the `|Y_{>=25}^+| >= 2` condition for MDL shaping, the exact Stage-2 learning-rate schedule `4.8e-6 -> 2.0e-6`, `--eq-shield` equation-fragment shielding rule, and steps 18-35 FP32 tail averaging for 35-step continuations (and steps 86-120 for the 120-step run), and `adv_norm='std'` with `mdl_schema_bonus=0.35` across the exploratory runs. (2) Bundled `code/vendor/reasoning_from_scratch/*.py` inside `supplement.zip`, replaced all `README.md` launcher commands with the exact CLI invocations matching `records/run_configs.json` (verified programmatically in `verify_supplement.py` via `build_arg_parser()`), and added `construct_all_m3_merges()` (`python code/recompute_weight_forensics.py --construct-merges`) with explicit `fp32_rmsnorm` settings and 0-diff bit-exact verification against all three evaluated merged `.pth` checkpoints (`val350_tessera_m3_majority`, `tessera_m3_sym_seed102`, `tessera_m3_cross_sym`), updating Table 2B2 and Table 3B2-B3 to match their exact verified parent checkpoints. (3) Corrected the training token and summed step-time entries in Table 4 (`138,012` tokens / `457.35 s` for `Baseline-Seed102` and `124,758` tokens / `437.77 s` for `Tessera-Sym-Seed42`, asserted in `verify_supplement.py`), corrected the steps 1-6 log comparison in Section 4.4 (rewards `0, 0, 0.375, 0.25, 0.5`, loss difference at step 3, grad_norm difference at step 5, reward divergence at step 6 without claiming an unverified boundary-weight flip), and added discussion and citations of VPPO (Liu et al., 2026) [20] and T-SPMO (Lee & Tong, 2025) [21].
title: Shared-Prefix Credit Shielding, Trajectory-Zero-Sum Efficiency Shaping, and a Bounded BF16 Weight-Space Audit in Small-Model RLVR
